title.en: What a Piston Name Does Not Turn Into
title.zh: 活塞这个名称不能变成什么

description.en: The catalogue names split and integral pistons for S-valve concrete pumps, and a rubber spring as a piston damping spring. It does not print a replacement procedure.
description.zh: 目录为S阀混凝土泵列出分体和整体活塞，并把橡胶弹簧称为活塞缓冲弹簧。它没有印更换步骤。

h1.en: What a Piston Name Does Not Turn Into
h1.zh: 活塞这个名称不能变成什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names split pistons and integral pistons for S-valve concrete pumps, and it names a rubber spring as a piston damping spring. Those words confirm that a piston is part of the published vocabulary. They do not print a removal sequence, a torque, an hour interval or a stroke length. Do not turn the part name into a workshop procedure. Performance numbers stay on the concrete pump page that prints them.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台为 S阀混凝土泵列出分体活塞和整体活塞，并把橡胶弹簧称为活塞缓冲弹簧。这些词确认活塞属于已公布的用词。它们没有印拆卸顺序、扭矩、小时间隔或行程长度。不要把零件名称写成车间步骤。性能数字留在印出它们的混凝土泵页面上。

body.en: Split piston, integral piston, and piston damping spring are catalogue names. The split-piston line also says the set is for S-valve concrete pumps. Hebei Pinjin Machinery stops at the name and the size lists on the part pages. This article does not copy those size lists.
body.zh: 分体活塞、整体活塞和活塞缓冲弹簧是目录名称。分体活塞一行还写明用于 S阀混凝土泵。河北品锦机械停在名称和配件页的尺寸清单。本文不抄那些尺寸清单。

heading.en: The steps that are not published

body.en: There is no printed order for pulling a piston, no oil grade in the pump specification table, and no hour at which a piston must be changed. An existing note on the site already refuses invented replacement hours. This page does not add a new interval.
body.zh: 没有印出拆活塞的顺序，泵的规格表里没有油品牌号，也没有必须更换活塞的小时数。站点上已有说明拒绝编造更换小时。本页不另加一个间隔。

body.en: For a listed size, open the piston or rubber-spring product page. For a figure the page does not contain, use /en/contact/. For output and distance, return to the concrete pump model, not the wear-part name.
body.zh: 要查已列尺寸，请打开活塞或橡胶弹簧的产品页。页面没有的数字，请用 /zh/contact/。产量和距离请回到混凝土泵型号，而不是易损件名称。

question.en: Does the catalogue name a piston?

answer.en: Yes. Split and integral pistons are named for S-valve concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 点了。分体和整体活塞被写明用于 S阀混凝土泵。

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print removal steps, torque or an hour interval.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有印拆卸步骤、扭矩或小时间隔。

question.en: What is the rubber spring called?

answer.en: A piston damping spring, in rubber or polyurethane, on its parts page.
answer.zh: 在配件页上称为活塞缓冲弹簧，材料为橡胶或聚氨酯。
